messages:
emma: Postmortem follow-up for auth rollout. Two repeat patterns: short 1-4m bursts that flood pages, and separate slow ramps >10m we sometimes miss. Need owners and conservative ETAs.

emma: Proposed actions:
1) Add hysteresis (require sustained windows) to auth-timeout alert.
2) Increase dedupe for auth-timeout and fingerprint by trace_id/session_id.
3) Quiet-hours mute for non-prod (22:30-07:00).
4) Runbook update with rollback + minimal verification.
5) CI smoke job that simulates bursty auth traffic + dashboard tile.

emma: Call out owners + ETA.

santosh: I'll take 1. Plan: p99 > 700ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows before paging. Backtest 14d and post graphs. ETA 20h.

lee: I'll take 2 & 3. Current dedupe is 90s; propose 6m for auth-timeout with fingerprint by trace_id, ignore internal-bot labels. Quiet-hours mute deploy ETA 3h. Dedupe PR ETA 36h.

alert-bot: Ticket created: ALERT-3211 "auth hysteresis + dedupe" -> assigned lee, santosh.

hana: I'll own 4 (runbook) and draft rollback steps + smoke test doc. Runbook PR by EOD.

ori: I'll add the dashboard tile and a burn-rate widget; will link traces. ETA 6h.

emma: Note: keep an override path so sustained incidents (>=8m at X% errors) bypass dedupe and escalate immediately.

santosh: good call. I'll include that in the alert config tests.

lee: Will add fingerprint fallback to session_id in case trace sampling drops keys.

emma: Owners recap: santosh=1(20h), lee=2(36h)+3(3h), hana=4(EOD), ori=5(6h). I'll seed the postmortem tracker and link tickets. Reconvene in 48h here for updates. :white_check_mark:
